Use case: illustration-story
Input image 1 is the paper-object/style reference ONLY; replace reference geography completely with this country.
Tactile mid-century travel-poster screen print: flat layered shapes, fine risograph grain, soft paper fibres, calm elegant Travary navy/teal/coral/sage/mustard/cream family, never photographic. No words, letters, numbers, pseudo-text, decorative script, inscriptions, signs, logos, watermarks, flags, faces or copyrighted characters. All vehicle panels/plates, boat hulls, tram windows and shopfronts blank and unmarked. Every tram/train destination board and front oval/badge is a COMPLETELY SOLID BLANK PANEL: no monogram, emblem, oval outline, route label, letter-like scratches or painted symbol. Windows empty dark glass. NO FLAGS OR FLAGPOLES, including tiny bridge-top pennants, roof flags, boat flags or decorative banners. Bridge arches have clean uninterrupted bare tops. Small people may only be featureless silhouettes; prefer empty streets. Exclude theme parks, Hollywood sign, Space Needle, Cloud Gate and casino buildings. Replace ALL unrelated American template scenery. Even for San Francisco, remove original desert mesas, cactus, snowy peaks and road-trip scenery; retain only this place's specified scene. Famous buildings belong within a balanced country composition, not giant isolated objects.
Country: Egypt. Scene: three stepped-triangle pyramids at golden hour on the desert's edge, a felucca with a white sail on the Nile, date palms, a temple with papyrus-bud columns, a camel silhouette, a strip of turquoise Red Sea (no hieroglyphs). Light: warm low golden sun. Stripe and tag: desert gold, Nile turquoise, lapis blue (#d1a75d, #398c98, #365d83). Keep all six pictures coherent in light, palette and landmarks.
One landscape 3:2 vintage postcard 1536 × 1024 PNG. Thin deckled warm-cream edge, faint soft shadow, centred and straight-on. Genuine transparency outside, NO opaque presentation backdrop. Same country scene recomposed with key subject in LEFT 60%; RIGHT 35% quieter, particularly upper right. No tags, postmarks, stamps or UI.
qaNotes: Inspected six selected illustrations, rejected two extra-pyramid originals, and inspected final light/dark exports. Exactly three pyramids per selected scene, white-sailed felucca, date palms, plain uninscribed papyrus-column temple, camel silhouette and turquoise water. Coherent gold/Nile turquoise/lapis palette; no hieroglyphs, script, flags, logos or real faces. Blanks, alpha, template details and export checks pass.
